calculation.non_solid_result: one fresh full-height value for each station
calculation.solid_entry_length: float(config['entry_taper_length']) only when config['entry_end_style'] equals PLATFORM_END_TAPERED; otherwise 0.0
calculation.solid_exit_length: float(config['exit_taper_length']) only when config['exit_end_style'] equals PLATFORM_END_TAPERED; otherwise 0.0
solid_station_sequence: apply the entry calculation only when entry length exceeds GEOMETRY_TOLERANCE and station is less than entry length
apply the exit calculation only when exit length exceeds GEOMETRY_TOLERANCE and platform_length minus station is less than exit length
use the lower entry or exit value when the two ranges overlap
calculation.non_finite_values: keep B14/B15 Python arithmetic and comparison behaviour
calculation.diagnostics: keep inherited Python exception type and text

caller_order: calculate relative stations and platform length
binding_checks: exact inherited constant types and values
product_routing.setup_failure: restore each prior host value and remove only a selected name that was originally absent

scope.supported: B14/B15 platform height calculation with the bounded B16 caller
excluded: new platform height, tolerance, branch or diagnostic behaviour
other platform geometry or full layout equivalence
stored state, production export or release changes
Phase 7 exit, performance, output or release acceptance
